fact: The Tanzania Police Force's criminal statistics unit, which receives data from all police stations, compiled the January-June 2025 crime and road-safety statistics report, issued in October 2025 with NBS, giving 293,890 criminal offences against 303,861 in January-June 2024.
title: Takwimu za Hali ya Uhalifu na Matukio ya Usalama Barabarani Januari - Juni 2025
publisher: Jeshi la Polisi Tanzania / Ofisi ya Taifa ya Takwimu
